topic: 渐进式电梯安全钳结构（示意）

claims.claim: the part is called a guide rail
lift guide rails guide the car (and counterweight); standard profile is T-type
claims.note: 「本标准适用于电梯中使用的供电梯轿厢和对重导向的导轨」

claims.claim: the progressive safety gear is mounted at both ends of the car's lower crosshead
claims.note: 「渐进式安全钳安装在电梯轿厢下横梁的两端」

claims.claim: braking force is applied by moving brake wedges
the pull-up mechanism moves the slider/wedge up the fixed incline until it meets and clamps the rail
claims.note: patent calls the moving part 滑块: 「沿固定楔块6斜面上移」「直至滑块5接触右导轨面」

claims.claim: braking force comes from paired disc springs
claims.note: 「制动力通常由成对的碟形弹簧和制动组件共同产生」

claims.claim: braking force is adjustable via the disc-spring packs
claims.note: 「制动力可通过碟形弹簧组件进行调节」

claims.claim: the gear has a pull-up (lifting) mechanism
claims.note: 「再使安全钳的提拉机构动作」

claims.claim: the overspeed governor acts first and then actuates the gear's pull-up mechanism
claims.note: 「电梯限速器装置首先动作」…「再使安全钳的提拉机构动作」

claims.text: 渐进式安全钳 · 结构示意，非实物尺寸
claims.claim: progressive safety gear is a real type; the subtitle flags the model as schematic

claims.text: 下行超速时，限速器先动作
claims.claim: on downward overspeed the governor acts first
claims.note: 「当电梯轿厢下行超速或因意外而坠落时，电梯限速器装置首先动作」

claims.text: 楔块夹紧导轨，轿厢被制停
claims.claim: the gear clamps the rail and stops the car
claims.note: 「安全钳夹紧导轨15，起到使电梯轿厢制停作用」

visual.what: two brass wedges, one on each side of the rail, each backed by a disc-spring stack inside an open yellow frame
visual.note: Commons photo shows the two-sided build; patent CN105329739A describes one moving slider against one rail face — designs differ, the film says 结构示意

visual.what: wedges rise relative to the body when the rod is pulled up, then stop on the rail
visual.note: 「提拉机构带动安全钳的滑块沿固定楔块6斜面上移」

visual.what: the rail is drawn with a T profile
